Dr. J.S. Rajkumar Addresses Concerns About HMPV and Spreads New Year Cheer

Health & Wellness #34 

Dr. J.S. Rajkumar discusses the emergence of the HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) and reassures the public that there is no cause for alarm.
